title: Save the Reef, Mauritius
description: The lagoon in Mauritius is a vibrant ecosystem, but it’s also fragile. These are bags of trash, not fish.  I try to leave every place I visit a little better than I found it.  The ocean needs our help, and I’m happy to do my part.

title: Giddy up
description: I love horses.  I have been riding since I was a child, and I have volunteered with animals in America, Mauritius and now Japan.

title: I love cooking food from around the world
description: I love this culinary school in Thailand. Thai food is vibrant and full of flavor. Fresh ingredients, bright colors, and new techniques make me a better cook.

title: India and Nepal
description: I spent a month in the Himalayas learning mountaineering at the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute in Darjeeling, India.  I also went bungee jumping and paragliding in Pokhara, Nepal.
